title: Chapter 166 Destroy The Soul Devouring Clan
content:
Chapter 166 Destroy The Soul Devouring Clan

Looking at the anxiety in God's eyes.

Lu Daosheng smiled and said, "Don't worry, there will be no trouble in the Divine Dynasty."

Hearing this, God breathed a sigh of relief.

"Let's go."

Lu Daosheng waved his hand lightly, and the space in front of him suddenly cracked.

Immediately, the two disappeared.

God is inward.

"Look, Lord Lu is back!"

"That's, it's General God One, General God One is really resurrected!"

"What?! Miracles, miracles!!"

Seeing Shen Yi beside Lu Daosheng, the entire imperial capital immediately cheered.

It can be seen how heavy the weight of God One is in the God's dynasty.

At this time, a figure rushed towards God quickly, and then knelt in front of God in the shocked eyes of everyone.

"The sinful general Guan Lin, have seen the general!"

Guan Lin burst into tears and his whole body was trembling slightly.

Looking at Guan Lin in front of him, the god-like expression was complicated, "Guan Lin, this is not your fault. It is already a blessing that you are still alive."

Seeing Guan Lin like this, Shen Yi knew what was going on.

But when Guan Lin heard Shen Yi's words, he felt like a knife was stolen inside.

"General.."

Shen Yi shook his head slightly.

At this time, Lu Xue slowly walked towards this place.

"father."

Lu Xue walked to Lu Daosheng's side and pulled the corner of Lu Daosheng's clothes.

However, Lu Daosheng shook his head slightly.

It’s not that he can’t do it, but that he can’t.

He believes Lu Xue will understand the specific reason in the future.

And this is also something that God must experience in this life.

Seeing this, Lu Xue sighed slightly, but continued, "Dad, can you take me to see my mother?"

Although I knew my mother was safe, I still wanted to go and have a look.

What's more, my father is back.

Then what else to worry about?

The sense of security next to Lu Daosheng is definitely full of it.

Upon hearing this, Lu Daosheng naturally did not refuse.

He missed his wife very much for so long after seeing her for so long.

"Okay, Xiaoxue, let's go."

Immediately, Lu Daosheng took Lu Xue's hand and left the Divine Dynasty directly.

"Hey! Master, little master!, you left me behind!!"

Inside the gods, Ao Qing whistled to the sky, but there was no response.

"Damn!"

At this time, Mr. Zhou slowly came to the side of the god standing on the city wall with his eyes lost.

Shen Yi now knows Lu Daosheng's identity.

Although he had some speculation, he was still shocked.

Your Majesty's man, no wonder.

"Shen Yi, don't think too much, you have tried your best."

Mr. Zhou looked at Shen Yi and sighed slightly.

God's expression remains unchanged.

"Lao Zhou, do you think there are really people in this world who can do anything?"

Hearing this question, Old Zhou looked slightly stunned.

But then he understood why God I asked this question.

Just as he was about to shake his head, he thought of Shen Yi who had just come back to life.

After a moment of silence, Mr. Zhou suddenly smiled and said, "I don't know if there is anything I do, but isn't this what we are practicing so hard?"

As soon as these words came out, God suddenly became enlightened.

Yes, what is the purpose of practicing?

Isn't it just for this?

Wasn't it because Yan Lingyun gave him an invincible feeling that he decided to follow Yan Lingyun.

And he has always aimed at Yan Lingyun.

In his opinion, Yan Lingyun is the kind of omnipotent person.

"By the way, Lao Zhou, how is Your Majesty?"

God asked.

Old Zhou raised his eyebrows and looked at the distant sky, chuckled, "I think the war was over the moment Lord Lu appeared."

.........

Unknown boundaries.

At this moment, only two figures were left here.

Yan Lingyun and the head of the Spirit-Devouring Clan.

After devouring almost half of the spirit-devouring race, his strength finally reached the point where he could compete with Yan Lingyun.

However, no matter how he used all his methods, he could never gain any advantage.

Now, he has completely lost his mind.

Yan Lingyun became his eternal inner demon.

"Woman, I will definitely kill you, I will definitely!!"

The Spirit Devouring used all his strength and roared at Yan Lingyun.

However, Yan Lingyun has not yet waited for her to reply.

A sound suddenly sounded from the depths of the starry sky.

"Who are you going to kill?"

Hearing this sound, the Spirit Devouring was slightly stunned.

Yan Lingyun stopped and slowly turned around to look.

laugh!

The space cracked and two figures appeared in the field.

"mother!"

When Lu Xue saw Yan Lingyun, she waved excitedly.

"Lingyun, I'm back."

Lu Daosheng looked at Yan Lingyun and said with a smile.

"I knew you would definitely come back."

At this moment, Yan Lingyun's powerful aura disappeared instantly, and replaced by tenderness in her eyes.

Yan Lingyun walked slowly towards Lu Daosheng and the others.

But an inappropriate curse came from behind.

"Don't you take me seriously?!"

The Spirit-Devouring Roared, and at this moment, he did not realize the seriousness of the matter at all.

Years of shame, coupled with the current setbacks, have already made him lose his mind.

However, the next moment, he would never worry about this.

boom!

A roar sounded.

Spirit Devourer stood there in a daze, and immediately realized that his body had become numb.

His eyes moved down, and a scream sounded.

"Ah!!!"

Seeing that Spirit Devourer was left with only a head floating in the void.

"Too noisy!"

Lu Daosheng frowned.

Lu Daosheng hated Spirit Devourer who disturbed his time with his family.

With a casual wave of his hand.

The Spirit Devourer was completely wiped out.

The Spirit Devourer Clan, who was so powerful, and whose patriarch was called a nightmare by countless strong men, completely disappeared from the world at this moment.

"Lingyun, wait for me."

Lu Daosheng smiled slightly, and then walked towards the depths of the starry sky.

With one step, Lu Daosheng instantly came to a dark area of nothingness.

This is the nest of the Spirit Devourer Clan.

The Spirit Devourer Realm.

All the power of the Spirit Devourer Clan fell in the Supreme Star Domain.

Now, there are only a few soul-devouring tribe members with little strength left in the soul-devouring world.

These are no threat to the world.

But Lu Daosheng is not a saint.

One day, the soul-devouring tribe here will give birth to another soul-devouring, and the nightmare will come to the world again.

So, what Lu Daosheng has to do is to kill them all.

"Next life, I hope I can be born into a good family."

For some reason, Lu Daosheng muttered to himself.

Then, a destructive force condensed from his hands.

"Destroy."

Buzz——

In an instant, the entire soul-devouring world turned into a bubble, and then slowly dissipated.

The soul-devouring world no longer exists.

Standing in the void, Lu Daosheng looked at the darkness in front of him with a calm expression.

After a long silence, Lu Daosheng was about to leave.

And at this moment, a wave slowly emerged from the depths of the void.
